method: research list (open data, source URLs per item) joined to the game: pand under the point, covers.json model, measured fronts, shop templates, market extract, distance to the routing network; score = route weight x open x ride visibility x verification (+0.5 monument), x0.4 when a bespoke model or market kit already stands, x0.6 for a measured hand front
sources: Overpass API https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter (2026-11-20; marketplace + named-building queries; first attempts got 502/at capacity)
Repo cache /Users/blackmad/Code/map-recall2/.cache/retail-ground/overpass.json (+overpass-extra.json), OSM base 2026-11-14 — read only
Wikidata SPARQL https://query.wikidata.org/sparql (wikibase:box over central Amsterdam with shop/café/market/etc. classes; VALUES detail query for P625/P359/P373/P6375/P856)
Wikidata wbsearchentities API for ~40 candidate names
Commons API categoryinfo for ~90 candidate category names
nl/en Wikipedia pages (Metz & Co, Maison de Bonneterie, Hirschgebouw, Magna Plaza, V&D)
Official websites (HTTP fetch of title/content) and web search for current status
RCE register not queried directly; rijksmonument numbers come from Wikidata P359 (or OSM ref for De Gooyer)
